newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Continued strong cash beef and outlook for further gains in cash cattle.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady. Index easier but corn called lower. May continue to take cue from back months cattle.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Mixed hog calls despite higher pork values. Some export concerns.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.200 to 0.500 cent. Technically very strong and cash product up on lighter hog kills.
